# Frozen state of the ONE venv on coriander: /m-coriander/coriander/kirill/mstar/.venv
# Captured 2026-08-10. Every GLM-5.2 number in the lane (49.65 tok/s, the
# acceptance profiles, the vLLM comparison) was measured against THIS set.
#
# Why this file exists: the venv is shared - the TP lane has no venv of its
# own and borrows this one, and the Dynamo Phase-0 session mutated it on
# 2026-08-09 (flash-attn, cudnn, ninja, and a REAL flashinfer, which is what
# silently un-stubbed the CPU MTP tests). There is no uv.lock and no uv cache
# on the box, so until this freeze existed the environment behind every
# measurement was unreproducible and drift was undetectable.
#
# Rebuild/compare:  .venv/bin/python -m pip freeze | sort | diff - env/coriander-venv-freeze.txt
# Do NOT rebuild a lane venv from a fresh resolve - it will not reproduce
# these versions, and the measurement baseline goes with them.
#
